notes.199: 'vurch' (line 202), lit. 'furrow', is taken figuratively as the contest. 'widervanc' (line 214) taken as the planets' retrograde motion.

nodes.text: against one another in the manner of a contest,
who would carry off the prize for song there.
Now Master Klingsor too had been
the power of all the elements,
and the order of all the stars,
in this he had no lack.
Now he had by this time come there
